Fill the vector control placeholders of a scenario table

Source: R/xml_export.R
om_scenario_values.Rd

Adds to the user's OpenMalaria scenario table (one row per scenario, built as the user wants, e.g. with expand.grid()) the values of the placeholders of a vector control intervention, row by row:

  • efficacies (<name>_deterrency, ...), when the intervention is a list of several nets: those of the net named in column net;

  • decay parameters (<name>_deterrency_L in years, <name>_deterrency_k, ...), when the intervention was defined with decay = "placeholder";

  • dummy-host availabilities (<name>_dummy_<k>_pop<j>) of dummy-host nets, when the net or the coverages vary: coverage of campaign \(k\) \(\times\) KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute / human availability of population \(j\), the coverages taken from the columns named like the coverage placeholders of the schedule (e.g. cov2021); the decay of the dummy hosts is that of host-seeking killing (<name>_hsk_L, <name>_hsk_k), filled as the other decays.

Only the placeholders written by define_OM_vector_control / deploy_OM_vector_control (or get_OM_xml) are filled: the intervention's record (nets, placeholders, populations, schedule) is read from source. The other columns and the row order are kept; the coverages and the scenario design stay the user's.

Decays. The decays differ between effects through the insecticide decay of each effect (from the net's parameterisation), while the attrition is common to all effects. With combine = TRUE (default), halflife and kappa name one attrition column each (e.g. a usage-adjusted attrition): each effect's decay is this attrition combined with the effect's own insecticide decay (fitted by a Weibull when needed, over fit_years of om_vector_control), host-seeking killing (the dummy hosts) included. With combine = FALSE, the columns are final decays, written as they are: one column per effect (named vector, e.g. c(Deterrency = "hl_det", PrePrandial = "hl_pre", PostPrandial = "hl_post", KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute = "hl_hsk")) or one column for all effects (host-seeking killing: the decay of the dummy hosts). Without columns, each net's own decay is used. Decay columns need an intervention defined with decay = "placeholder".

Half-life and shape are replaced independently: a kappa column alone changes the shape and keeps the half-life (and the other way round), the rest coming from the net (its attrition with combine = TRUE; its exported decay of the effect with combine = FALSE). Values must be positive numbers (the shape only where the decay function has one); errors name the rows and the effect.

Values are computed once per distinct net and decay, so large tables are fast.

Usage

om_scenario_values(
  scenarios,
  source,
  name = NULL,
  net = NULL,
  halflife = NULL,
  kappa = NULL,
  decay_unit = c("years", "days"),
  combine = TRUE
)

Arguments

scenarios

Data frame of scenarios (one row per scenario).

source

The baseList after define_OM_vector_control() and deploy_OM_vector_control(), or the result of get_OM_xml().

name

Name of the intervention (optional with get_OM_xml()).

net

Column naming the net of each row (the names of the list given to define_OM_vector_control()); needed when the list has several nets.

halflife, kappa

Columns of decay parameters (see Decays): half-life (or time to zero, for linear / step decays) and shape, each optional. Interventions specified with om_vector_control() are needed for combine = TRUE.

decay_unit

Unit of the halflife columns: "years" (default, as OpenMalaria) or "days". Written values are in years.

combine

Logical (default TRUE): halflife / kappa are an attrition combined with each effect's insecticide decay; FALSE: final decays.

Value

scenarios with one column per placeholder, named without the @.

See also

define_OM_vector_control, om_campaigns

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
nets = list(martin  = om_vector_control(get_ITN_params("Interceptor G2", "Martin"),
                                        halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2),
            assenga = om_vector_control(get_ITN_params("Interceptor G2", "Assenga"),
                                        halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2))
baseList = define_OM_vector_control(baseList, nets, name = "futITN",
                                    decay = "placeholder")
baseList = deploy_OM_vector_control(baseList, "futITN",
    om_campaigns("2019-01-25", "2030-01-25", coverage = "@futITNcov@"))
scens = expand.grid(net = c("martin", "assenga"), halflife = c(1, 2, 3),
                    futITNcov = c(0.5, 0.8))
scens = om_scenario_values(scens, baseList, "futITN", net = "net",
                           halflife = "halflife")
} # }
